source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # The long full-color-2 line is the boundary; translate the non-background
    # object toward it, then draw color 8 just beyond the object on its far side.
    line_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    line_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if line_row is not None:
        obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
        if not obj:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c,v in obj), max(r for r,c,v in obj)
        if hi < line_row:
            shift = line_row - 1 - hi
        else:
            shift = line_row + 1 - lo
        out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for c in range(w): out[line_row][c] = 2
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r+shift][c] = v
        far = (lo+shift-1) if hi < line_row else (hi+shift+1)
        if 0 <= far < h:
            out[far] = [8]*w
        return out
    if line_col is not None:
        obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
        if not obj:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c,v in obj), max(c for r,c,v in obj)
        if hi < line_col:
            shift = line_col - 1 - hi
        else:
            shift = line_col + 1 - lo
        out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h): out[r][line_col] = 2
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c+shift] = v
        far = (lo+shift-1) if hi < line_col else (hi+shift+1)
        if 0 <= far < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][far] = 8
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
